idle: Big boss up on the brewery roof says double shifts tonight.
taunt: You think we run this? Look up at the brewery roof, gramps.

idle: Every fry we swipe goes up to the brewery roof. Boss's cut.
Don't ask who's on the brewery roof. Just keep the tower sign lit.
Heard the big boss on the brewery roof only got one good eye. Still sees all.

taunt: Beat us all you want. The guy on the brewery roof pulls the strings, hon.

intro: Ew, old people! Mech, crunch 'em into crumbs!
This is MY pavilion! Mom said I could have it!
Taste the seasoning cloud, grandpa! Sneeze, sneeze!
defeat: My mech! You popped my bag! I'm telling!
This is SO unfair! You didn't even let me win!
Fine! I didn't want this dumb harbor anyway! Hmph!

intro: Welcome to my roof, Harold. Every gang in town pours through me.
One eye's all I need to see you're finished, toad.
The sign's lit, the harbor's mine. Last call, old-timer.
phase2: You knocked the foam off my head. Now I'm angry.
Stack the cans! Time for the tower slam!
Watch the mustache, toad. It spins faster than it looks.
defeat: My tower... my sign... my whole operation, flat.
Tapped out... by a toad with a cane...
Fine. The harbor's yours. Mind the stairs going down.

finale.speaker: brewmaster
finale.text: Rats, gulls, bandits... all mine. And you beat every one.

finale.speaker: harold
finale.text: Forty years walking this harbor. You don't get to keep it.

finale.speaker: mavis
finale.text: And twirl that mustache at me again, I'll use the handbag.

finale.speaker: brewmaster
finale.text: Heh. Somebody switch off the sign. Closing time.

finale.speaker: harold
finale.text: Come on, Mavis. Let's go watch the boats, hon.

boat_ambush: This boat ride is hijacked! The Duchess steers now!
Lovely day for a paddle. Shame I'm commandeering it!
All aboard? Wrong! This ride's mine, peasants!

harborplace.name: HARBORPLACE
blurb: Harborplace opened in 1980 as two shopping pavilions on the Inner Harbor.
Now a bratty kid in a chip-bag mech calls dibs on the whole waterfront.
